description: Rebuilds an existing ad with a change the user asked for, such as other wording, colors or images. It uses up one of the changes left, and one free change is included, so call it only when the user asked for this change, and pass their request as they said it. The new version takes a few minutes: follow it with get_ad_status.

change.description: What the user wants changed, in their words (3 to 1000 characters).

name: request_change

ad_id.description: The new version of the ad.

title: Change a video ad
